decisions.reason: Garage door operators build on existing electromechanical and production knowledge, and ongoing learning has lowered the risk of withdrawal.
The remote-control variant leverages the same operator platform with only added electronic components, keeping it within the firm's absorptive capacity.
Glazed industrial sectional doors are a direct extension of the firm's established industrial door range, making early results easy to interpret and improve.
Insulated glazed industrial sectional doors combine the firm's existing glazing and insulation capabilities, giving it the highest absorptive capacity among the new products.
This glazed industrial sectional door is closely related to existing products and has dedicated market presence, indicating clear early results and continued fit.
